'''Miltar Dolor''' was a [[Gender/Legends|male]] individual who worked for the [[Corporate Sector Authority/Legends|Corporate Sector Authority]]. He once acted as a CSA representative at a party that was held by the [[Hutt/Legends|Hutt]] [[Popara Anjiliac Diresto]] on the [[Moon/Legends|moon]] [[Nar Shaddaa/Legends|Nar Shaddaa]]. Following Popara's [[Death/Legends|death]], the Hutt [[Zonnos Anjiliac Priare]] had Dolor killed.
